title: VTA DIDs — Keys List — payload
description: List the key roles of a key-role identity a VTA holds keys for: each role's keys and their states, the update authority and recovery commitment, and optionally the rotation history, in the public or custody projection (CONVENTIONS.md §11).

did.description: The key-role identity, by DID (for a `did:scid` identity, the DID without `src`).

roles.description: Return only these roles. Absent returns every role. Present-but-empty is refused by the schema rather than read as 'every role'.

includeEnded.description: Include `retired` and `revoked` keys. Absent reads as false. A `revoked` key the document still lists is always included.

includeHistory.description: Include the rotation history. Absent reads as false.

Response.title: VTA DIDs — Keys List — response payload

versionId.description: The version the answer describes. Pass it as `expectedVersionId` to a change made on its strength.

roles.description: One entry per role asked for, including roles with no keys.

rotations.description: Present exactly when `includeHistory` was true. Newest first.
